Version 1.2.0

React from the chat card.

Smart Automation pauses at the point where a player or GM can change the outcome, then carries the action forward once those choices are resolved.

When the card pauses

  • Before the roll. Eligible reactions can change what happens at declaration. Counterspell resolves its save, including any counter to the Counterspell, before the original spell proceeds.
  • After a hit, miss, or failed save. Use Shield on an eligible hit, Precision Attack on a miss, or Flash of Genius on a failed save. If a correction changes the outcome, the card checks for the next eligible choices.
  • After damage is rolled. See the damage before deciding whether to spend a resource on Parry, Song of Defense, or another supported reduction. Smart Automation waits before applying HP changes.

GM controls

Players can use or decline their own available choices from chat. The GM can use Decline Reaction to close the remaining choices in that window and continue the action. The GM can also take over a pending saving throw. If a result needs correction after application, use the card’s Undo control, make the correction, then reapply.

Open Module Options → Reaction Triggers to configure reaction pauses. Individual feature switches remain under Automations.

Read the GM Automation guide

Before you update

Requires Foundry VTT 14 and D&D5e 6.1.0 or later. Verified on Foundry 14.370 and D&D5e 6.1.0.
